inj.note: Darnold already has been ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Cardinals, and the combination of the quadriceps injury and cracked ribs he suffered last Monday against the Bears is threatening to sideline him for multiple weeks. The Seahawks have a Week 11 bye on the schedule, so getting him healthy for the stretch run from late November through early January may sway the team's decision-making. As long as Darnold is out, Drew Lock (right elbow) will direct Seattle's offense.

news.h: Drew Lock overcomes oblique injury in fill-in start for Sam Darnold, Seahawks
news.d: Already dealing with an injury to his throwing elbow, Drew Lock hurt his oblique in the third quarter of Seattle's 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals at Lumen Field.

news.h: Sources: Seahawks' Sam Darnold in jeopardy of missing Week 10 game vs. Raiders
news.d: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold, who is out Sunday against the Cardinals, also is in danger of missing Seattle's Week 10 game against the Raiders.

news.h: Seahawks' Quenton Nelson, Sam Darnold among starters ruled out
news.d: New Seahawks trade acquisition Quenton Nelson will have a "minor procedure" and is one of six starters, including QB Sam Darnold, who won't play vs. the Cardinals.

news.h: Seahawks' Lock says elbow feeling 'better' ahead of start vs. Cardinals
news.d: Seattle Seahawks backup quarterback Drew Lock, who's in line to start this week with Sam Darnold sidelined, says the elbow injury that made him inactive for the past two games is "doing a lot better."

news.h: Coach: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold ruled out with quad injury, is week-to-week
news.d: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will miss Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals because of a quad injury, coach Mike Macdonald announced Wednesday.
